The '''75th Legion''' was a unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was renowned as the personal legion of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vago]]. Members of the Legion possessed a cult-like devotion to Vago, proudly marching into battle in his name as he led them to numerous victories, and Vago treated his legionnaires as he would as his own children.<ref name="TOR Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The 75th Legion}}</ref>

[[File:75th_Legion_forward_camp.png|left|thumb|The [[75th Legion forward camp|75th Legion's forward camp]].]]
They were deployed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and established the [[75th Legion forward camp]], where they planned tactics and were responsible for neutralizing some of the [[Galactic Republic]] operations on the [[Tularan Marsh]], weakening the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] significantly.<ref name="TOR Bonus" /> One of these operations was the [[Tularan Marsh offensive|destruction]] of a secret unfinished hangar inside which the Republic planned to amass a fleet to rival the Empires above Taris.<ref name="TOR Bonus3">{{TORcite|type=bonus|The Hidden Hangar|Taris}}</ref>
